_readme:
Per-category measurement tolerance in centimetres, editable in Settings > Tolerances. Lives on the persistent disk like the other editable configs, so this repo copy is only a SEED for a fresh install.

APPAREL IS THE ONLY ONE THAT SCORES ANYTHING. Its value is the pass/fail threshold for every apparel size-chart row, and it is stored as 'toleranceCm' in fits.json (where passFail.js, pdfBuilder.js, app.js and approval.js all already read it) - NOT here. The apparel entry below is ignored on read; /api/tolerances substitutes the live fits.json value so there is exactly one source of truth. Saving the apparel row writes back to fits.json.

Every other category is a reference figure only: non-apparel dimensions are recorded but never compared against a standard, so these numbers are shown to the inspector on the Sizing step and used in no calculation. null means no tolerance is defined and no reference card is shown.
